tablet_felix: Highly variable. Day 16 AM (09:31) was coffee_table_l1; Day 15 PM was coffee_table_l1; Day 15 evening was kitchen_table_k1. Stop assuming nightstand_b1. Check coffee_table_l1 for morning/afternoon, kitchen_table_k1 for evening.

book_felix: Consistently at coffee_table_l1 in the afternoon. Day 16 AM (09:37) was coffee_table_l1; Day 15 (12:44) and Day 14 (15:54) were coffee_table_l1. Stop assuming couch_l1. Check coffee_table_l1.

glasses_felix: New pattern. Day 16 AM (09:56) was coffee_table_l1. Previous assumption of desk_b1 was wrong. Check coffee_table_l1 for morning queries.

mug_felix: Variable location. Day 16 PM (17:38) was kitchen_table_k1; Day 15 PM (17:39) was coffee_table_l1; Day 15 evening (18:50) was kitchen_table_k1. No single fixed spot. Check both coffee_table_l1 and kitchen_table_k1 depending on time.

glass_felix: Variable location. Day 16 evening (22:59) was cupboard_k1; Day 15 evening (22:09) was counter_k1. Stop assuming counter_k1 is the only evening spot. Check both counter_k1 and cupboard_k1 in the evening.

razor_felix: Persistent morning error. Assumed sink_ba_ba1; actually at bathroom_shelf_ba1 on Day 15 (09:17), Day 14 (07:56), Day 13 (08:55), and Day 7. Stop checking the sink for morning queries; check bathroom_shelf_ba1.

water_bottle_felix: Assumed dish_rack_k1 or entry_floor_e1; actually at coffee_table_l1 on Day 15 (12:49) and Day 14 (14:29). Check coffee_table_l1 for water bottles in the afternoon.
